texts.orig: It won’t surprise anyone that machine learning and data engineering roles are the fastest-growing in tech right now, growing 79% and 55% year over year, respectively. texts.text: It won’t surprise anyone that machine learning and data engineering roles are the fastest-growing in tech right now, growing 79% and 55% year over year, respectively. This is building on the growth of last year, when companies were already getting excited about AI, so there’s only increasing demand for these roles.

texts.label: text
